name: ACE-Step v1.5 High Quality (XL SFT) Fast
description: Music Generation Foundation Model v1.5 (XL SFT, max quality)

paragraphs: Note on this fork: the default DiT model was switched from acestep-v15-xl-turbo (8-step, guidance-distilled, optimized for speed) to acestep-v15-xl-sft (50-step, full classifier-free guidance, optimized for audio quality — the 5B-parameter XL checkpoint, not guidance-distilled). This is the highest-quality checkpoint ACE-Step currently publishes; it is the same weights as ACE-Step/acestep-v15-xl-sft-diffusers, just loaded through this repo's native handler instead of HF diffusers. Set the SERVICEMODEDITMODEL Space variable back to acestep-v15-xl-turbo if you want the fast/turbo behavior…
features: ✅ Ultra-Fast Generation — 0.5s to 10s generation time on A100 (depending on think mode & diffusion steps)
✅ Flexible Duration — Supports 10 seconds to 10 minutes (600s) audio generation
✅ Batch Generation — Generate up to 8 songs simultaneously
✅ Commercial-Grade Output — Quality between Suno v4.5 and Suno v5
✅ Rich Style Support — 1000+ instruments and styles with fine-grained timbre description
